concept: A crankshaft drives four slider-cranks; the fourth piston's rings and pin separate to expose sealing and attachment, and a separate cutaway reveals the reference drawing's cooling gallery.
scope: Original teaching reconstruction inspired by the user's VW SSP image. Not OEM CAD, production tolerances, a combustion simulation or an assertion that the user's GTI uses the pictured gallery piston.

model.rod_scope: Audi evo4 research-engine reference; Canadian2024GTI part match outstanding
model.other_geometry: Illustrative, including cylinder spacing, piston exterior, pin and ring sizes.

crankshaft: one crankshaft with five main-journal regions, eight webs, four crankpins, counterweights and an end flange

cooling_scope: SSP822223 illustrates a gallery. AudiSSP683 distinguishes PC3 cooling-gallery piston changes from PC2; the animation cannot identify this GTI's piston part number.
rendering_note: Integral casting features and curved bodies are split into painter-sortable pieces. Rod cap, bearing shells and fastener locations are not separately dimensioned or decomposed.
